newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE July wheat up A$7.50/tonne in light trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE July wheat up A$7.50/tonne in light trade.

text.p: SYDNEY, Jan 3 - July wheat futures were pushed $A7.50 a tonne higher in light-volume trading on the Sydney futures Exchange (SFE) on Friday.
Grains traders said July wheat found support on the back of higher wheat prices overnight on CBOT, despite the lack of interest overall on the SFE floor on Friday.
A single 50-tonne lot of July wheat was traded.
Nearby January wheat fell 50 cents to A$161.50 a tonne on volume of one lot.
An easing of freighter availability for exportable grains was placing some downward pressure on January wheat, grains traders said.
